name: s2111
signature: int s2111(int *aa, int n, int ld)

contract.execution: One execution of the original repetition-loop body, including local setup. Retain the explicitly reviewed post-loop computation.

scalar_output.source_computation: temp = 0.; for (int i = 0; i < LEN2; i++) for (int j = 0; j < LEN2; j++) temp += aa[i][j]; if (temp == 0) temp = 3.;

contract.aliasing: Distinct array arguments must have non-overlapping storage, matching the original globals. No restrict qualifier is added.
contract.arithmetic: Every evaluated signed arithmetic expression must be representable as int. Signed overflow is not defined as wraparound.
contract.memory: All array arguments are valid initialized buffers, also when n=0. No alignment beyond int alignment is required.
contract.empty_input: No array writes; the original zero-checksum fallback returns 3, including n=0.
contract.notes: Retain the post-loop sum and its zero-to-three fallback, not just the wavefront writes.

row_stride.padding: Columns [n, ld) of each row are preserved.
row_stride.allocation: The mathematical n*ld*sizeof(int) must fit in SIZE_MAX and in the supplied allocation.

adaptations: remove harness and execute one computational repetition
square matrices -> flat row-major buffers with explicit shared ld; packed arrays stay contiguous
expose postlude's scalar observation as the return value
retain reviewed post-loop summation; replace global temp by a returned local checksum

testing.description: Full [-3,3] inputs for n<=8; otherwise set only row/column boundaries to a bounded six-period wave f(i-j), with f(k)=f(k-1)+f(k+1). Interior inputs remain independently initialized.
